categories.main_business_segments: KOAS CO., LTD primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of office furniture, including desks, chairs, drawers, cabinets, panels, and related products. The company also engages in interior partition construction, kitchen equipment manufacturing and sales, medical equipment manufacturing, curtain and bedding production, mattress and built-in bed manufacturing, real estate sales and leasing, and e-commerce. Their focus is on office furniture with an emphasis on smart office solutions and ergonomic designs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a combination of labor-intensive and technology-intensive manufacturing processes, employing materials such as wood, steel, plastic, and MDF. KOAS emphasizes system furniture design integrating functionality and aesthetics, with proprietary product development teams for chairs, desks, and panels. They maintain in-house production facilities and collaborate with subcontractors for large-scale manufacturing, leveraging smart office concepts and ergonomic research to innovate their product lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KOAS serves primarily corporate clients, government agencies, educational institutions, hospitals, and military facilities. Their office furniture targets organizations requiring efficient, ergonomic, and functional office environments. The company also targets the education and healthcare sectors and is expanding into overseas markets and online retail channels. Their major customers are large enterprises and public institutions involved in large-scale procurement projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with production facilities in Paju, Gimpo, Busan, Daegu, Daejeon, and Gwangju. KOAS has also pursued overseas markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Japan through its overseas sales team. Although they had a subsidiary in Dalian, China, it was liquidated in 2022. They participate in international furniture exhibitions to strengthen export competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: KOAS operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and assembler of office furniture products. They source raw materials such as PB boards, steel plates, and plastic components from suppliers and produce finished goods in-house or through subcontractors. The company also manages distribution through a network of approximately 330 dealerships and direct sales channels, positioning itself close to the end customer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in ergonomic office furniture, smart office solutions, and environmentally friendly products. KOAS maintains dedicated teams for product development, design, and new business initiatives, investing around 1.14% of sales in R&D. Their innovation history includes development of functional panels, electronic educational furniture, and height-adjustable desks. They emphasize design differentiation, user comfort, and sustainability, aiming to lead domestic office environment trends.
categories.revenue_model: KOAS generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured office furniture products, both domestically and via exports. Sales channels include dealerships, direct sales to corporate and government clients, public procurement through the Korean Public Procurement Service, and online platforms. Revenue is derived from product sales, with some minor income from construction services and real estate leasing. Payment terms include cash and promissory notes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KOAS competes mainly with two other major Korean office furniture companies, Fursys and Livart, forming a triopoly in the domestic market. While KOAS holds a smaller market share (around 16% in 2022) compared to Fursys (63%) and Livart (21%), it is recognized for its design innovation and quality. The market is highly competitive with many small manufacturers, but large projects and public tenders are dominated by these three major players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: KOAS is a mid-sized company with total assets around 70.4 billion KRW and annual sales of approximately 71.7 billion KRW in 2023, showing a decline from previous years. The company experienced a net loss of about 6.7 billion KRW in 2023, reflecting challenging market conditions. Despite recent revenue contraction and operating losses, KOAS maintains stable capital and equity positions, with ongoing efforts to improve operational efficiency and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOAS differentiates itself through ergonomic, smart office furniture designs that enhance workplace productivity and employee well-being. The company emphasizes high-quality materials, innovative functionality, and environmentally friendly products, supported by numerous patents and design awards. Their comprehensive customer service, including rapid after-sales support and extensive dealer network, further strengthens their competitive edge. KOAS positions itself as a leader in creating comfortable, efficient, and sustainable office environments.
